title: COMP Panel Page
summary: Official Derivative common Panel page reference for display, enable, help DAT, cursor, touch, mouse, resize, reposition, and scroll overlay behavior on Panel COMPs.
guidance: Use this article when Panel COMP visibility, enable state, rollover help, cursor, mouse, touch, resize, reposition, or scroll-overlay behavior is relevant.
Changing display can incur layout processing costs; for simple overlays, prefer adjusting opacity when hiding the panel visually is enough.
Built-in Multi-Touch processes the first touch like a mouse click; disable it when a custom Multi Touch In DAT workflow should own touch handling.
Click Through makes the panel ignore mouse clicks, so do not combine it with expected panel interaction.
Anchor Drag determines whether drag-to-reposition edits anchor values or offset values when the panel uses anchor layout modes.
